messages.text: I found the Hammer Miner BC04 cheaper on a different website. Can you price match?
Read the hammer miner bc04 page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04

I can't do a price match, I'm afraid. Our prices are as listed, and the BC04 is $249 with the power supply and cord, in stock now at $249 for 6 TH/s at about 100W.

I've passed your request to Georges so he can look at it himself. The team is offline right now and picks it up Monday at 10am ET, and the answer comes to your email.

If it helps while you decide: at ~100W the BC04 is the most efficient unit we sell at that price, cheaper to run than the same-priced NerdQaxe++ at ~150W.
